reason: I want to secure the first specimen for the trip, and the flight locker is its natural destination.
expectation: I expect the membrane specimen to be placed in the flight locker, though it may need another step to be secured.

alternatives.reason: Harvesting lettuce could satisfy the garden goal, but I want to stow the specimen first.

effect: Placing the membrane in the flight locker completed the specimen goal, so the garden is the remaining task.
reaction: It was reassuring to get the first specimen aboard.
reason: Harvesting the new lettuce leaves is the available action toward taking some of the garden along.
expectation: I expect to cut some lettuce leaves that can be taken to the flight galley.

effect: The harvest produced departure lettuce leaves, ready for the flight galley.
reaction: It is satisfying to take something from the garden along.
reason: The flight galley is the only offered combination and seems the natural place to bring the leaves aboard.
expectation: I expect the leaves to be prepared or stored for the flight and the garden goal to be completed.

effect: The leaves became a fresh meal for the flight, completing the garden goal and the chapter.
reaction: The meal box clicking shut was a satisfying, quiet way to bring the garden along.

mostWorthwhile.text: Packing the lettuce into a flight meal was the most worthwhile moment: the handful of green connected the departure to the garden under the window.

leastWorthwhile.text: Cutting the lettuce produced leaves without any further detail, so it felt like a routine intermediate step.

surprise.text: The first specimen goal was completed simply by placing the membrane in the flight locker; I had expected it might need another securing step.

arbitrary.text: None of the actions felt arbitrary: the locker and galley were clear destinations, and the scissors were a natural way to harvest leaves.

continue.text: I would choose to continue because I am curious what the receiving lab will learn from the specimens, though this chapter's actions were straightforward.
